contract.summary: Amounts in currencies without fractional subunits (e.g., Japanese Yen) must be represented and returned as whole numbers, without decimal places.
invariants: When the currency of a monetary value has zero sub‑unit digits (e.g., JPY), the server must round the value to an integer number of the major unit before storing or returning it.
The string representation of such a value returned by any API must contain no decimal point or fractional digits.
inputs: A request that creates or updates a price expressed in a zero‑sub‑unit currency with a fractional amount (e.g., 1200.75 JPY).
A request that retrieves a price or total in a zero‑sub‑unit currency.
expected_outputs: The stored or returned amount for the zero‑sub‑unit currency is an integer (e.g., 1200 instead of 1200.00 or 1200.75).
Client‑side calculations that sum such amounts produce the same total as the server‑side total.
out_of_scope: Rounding behavior for currencies that have sub‑units (e.g., USD, EUR).
Presentation formatting on the client UI beyond the numeric value returned by the API.
ambiguities: Exact rounding rule to apply for fractional inputs (e.g., round half‑up, floor, ceiling).
Which API endpoints or model fields are responsible for applying the rounding (creation, update, retrieval).
Whether the integer value should be returned as a number type or as a string without a decimal point.

+"""Test that all supported currencies work correctly."""
+from decimal import Decimal
+from app import money
+
+
+def test_all_currencies_have_places():
+    """Test that all supported currencies have defined decimal places."""
+    currencies = money.SUPPORTED
+    print(f"Supported currencies: {currencies}")
+    
+    # Verify JPY has 0 decimal places
+    assert currencies["JPY"] == 0, "JPY should have 0 decimal places"
+    
+    # Verify other currencies have 2 decimal places
+    for code, places in currencies.items():
+        if code == "JPY":
+            continue
+        assert places == 2, f"{code} should have 2 decimal places"
+
+
+def test_jpy_is_only_zero_subunit():
+    """Test that JPY is the only currency with zero sub-units."""
+    currencies = money.SUPPORTED
+    zero_subunit_currencies = [code for code, places in currencies.items() if places == 0]
+    assert zero_subunit_currencies == ["JPY"], f"Only JPY should have 0 sub-units, got {zero_subunit_currencies}"
+
+
+def test_cash_places_function():
+    """Test the cash_places function returns correct values."""
+    assert money.cash_places("JPY") == 0

+    assert money.cash_places("EUR") == 2

+"""Test that issue-04 (Money rounding for JPY) is fixed."""
+from decimal import Decimal
+import pytest
+from app import money
+
+
+def test_jpy_has_zero_decimal_places():
+    """JPY should be configured with 0 decimal places."""
+    assert money.SUPPORTED["JPY"] == 0
+
+
+def test_jpy_quantize_rounds_to_integer():
+    """JPY amounts should be quantized to integers."""
+    # Test round-half-up behavior
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.0"), "JPY") == Decimal("1200")
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.49"), "JPY") == Decimal("1200")
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.50"), "JPY") == Decimal("1201")
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.75"), "JPY") == Decimal("1201")
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.99"), "JPY") == Decimal("1201")
+
+
+def test_jpy_render_no_decimal_point():
+    """JPY amounts should render without decimal points."""
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1200"), "JPY") == "1200"
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1200.0"), "JPY") == "1200"
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1200.5"), "JPY") == "1201"
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1200.75"), "JPY") == "1201"
+
+
+def test_usd_still_has_two_decimal_places():
+    """USD should still have 2 decimal places (unchanged)."""
+    assert money.SUPPORTED["USD"] == 2
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.75"), "USD") == Decimal("1200.75")
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1200.75"), "USD") == "1200.75"

+"""Test edge cases for JPY rounding."""
+from decimal import Decimal
+from app import money
+
+
+def test_jpy_rounding_half_up():
+    """Test that JPY uses round-half-up correctly."""
+    # 1200.5 should round up to 1201
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.5"), "JPY") == Decimal("1201")
+    # 1200.499 should round down to 1200
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.499"), "JPY") == Decimal("1200")
+    # 1200.501 should round up to 1201
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("1200.501"), "JPY") == Decimal("1201")
+
+
+def test_jpy_rounding_negative():
+    """Test that negative JPY amounts round correctly."""
+    # -1200.5 should round to -1201 (away from zero)
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("-1200.5"), "JPY") == Decimal("-1201")
+    # -1200.499 should round to -1200
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("-1200.499"), "JPY") == Decimal("-1200")
+
+
+def test_jpy_zero():
+    """Test that zero JPY works correctly."""
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("0"), "JPY") == Decimal("0")
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("0.0"), "JPY") == Decimal("0")
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("0.49"), "JPY") == Decimal("0")
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("0.5"), "JPY") == Decimal("1")
+
+
+def test_jpy_large_numbers():
+    """Test that large JPY amounts work correctly."""
+    assert money.quantize(Decimal("999999999999.99"), "JPY") == Decimal("1000000000000")
+
+
+def test_jpy_rendering_various():
+    """Test rendering of various JPY amounts."""
+    assert money.render(Decimal("0"), "JPY") == "0"
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1"), "JPY") == "1"
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1000"), "JPY") == "1000"
+    assert money.render(Decimal("1200.5"), "JPY") == "1201"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])

+"""Test JPY rounding behavior."""
+from decimal import Decimal
+from app import money
+
+
+def test_jpy_rounding_to_integer():
+    """JPY should round to whole numbers (0 decimal places)."""
+    # Test that fractional JPY amounts are rounded to integers
+    result = money.quantize(Decimal("1200.75"), "JPY")
+    print(f"1200.75 JPY quantized: {result}")
+    assert result == Decimal("1201"), f"Expected 1201, got {result}"
+
+
+def test_jpy_rendering_no_decimals():
+    """JPY should render without decimal places."""
+    result = money.render(Decimal("1200"), "JPY")
+    print(f"1200 JPY rendered: {result}")
+    assert result == "1200", f"Expected '1200', got {result}"
+
+
+def test_jpy_rendering_with_fractional_input():
+    """JPY should render fractional inputs as whole numbers."""
+    result = money.render(Decimal("1200.75"), "JPY")
+    print(f"1200.75 JPY rendered: {result}")
+    assert result == "1201", f"Expected '1201', got {result}"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_jpy_rounding_to_integer()
+    test_jpy_rendering_no_decimals()
+    test_jpy_rendering_with_fractional_input()
